_comment: Contract for authoritative-sources.md, read by BOTH tests/test_platform_pki.py and scripts/smoke_offline.sh via skills/shared/lib/doc_citations.py. Previously each of those two files carried its own hardcoded list of Splunk URL slugs, so a vendor rename meant editing three places and presented as a local test failure -- which happened twice while Splunk migrated docs.splunk.com to help.splunk.com. Matching is on the link TITLE (authored here, stable) plus a normalised topic token from the slug (confirms the URL is plausibly the right page without re-encoding the vendor's current spelling). Normalisation strips case and separators, so CustomCertsKVstore and preparing-custom-certificates-for-use-with-kv-store both satisfy the kvstore token. A vendor migration is now a one-line URL edit in authoritative-sources.md with no test change.
_liveness_note: This contract deliberately does NOT check that URLs resolve. Liveness belongs to the scheduled repository-wide documentation citation audit, while lifecycle-changing redirects receive a separate scheduled audit; duplicating either here would make an offline unit test depend on the network.
